watch.en: Acid in the marinade, such as lemon or lime juice, turns fish from translucent to white.
watch.de: Säure in der Marinade, etwa Zitronen- oder Limettensaft, macht Fisch von glasig zu weiß.

why.en: The acid changes the protein into a form that is in many cases edible.
why.de: Die Säure verändert das Eiweiß in eine Form, die in vielen Fällen essbar ist.

sources.title: Garde Manger: A Guide to the Cold Kitchen (Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Did you notice the protein turn from a translucent color to a white opaque color?

sources.title: Garde Manger: A Guide to the Cold Kitchen (Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: In the simplest form, it means that the acid is changing the protein into a form that in many cases is edible.
